newsitem.title: JAPAN: S&P assigns AAA to Orico Asset Funding Japan notes.
newsitem.headline: S&P assigns AAA to Orico Asset Funding Japan notes.

text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp said on Monday that it had assigned its AAA rating to Orico Asset Funding Japan's (OAFJ) 30 billion yen worth of Series Two fixed-rate notes.

The notes comprise 7.2 billion yen worth of class A 0.74 percent notes, 10.0 billion yen worth of class B 0.89 percent notes, 8.0 billion yen worth of class C 1.41 percent notes and 4.8 billion yen worth of class D 1.66 percent notes, S&P said in a statement.
The final maturity date for the Series Two notes is March 2002, S&P said.
